nodes.name: Returns (RMA)
nodes.description: Two mechanisms share the word: the legacy admin RMA record, and the buyer self-service flow (draft, submit, cancel, agent decision, buyer notifications) that now also has an organization view for permission holders.

evidence.note: PlatformUserGuide Return module overview, quoted in the map: view and manage all return operations; the buyer self-service flow is documented nowhere published (D7)

GET /api/platform/modules lists VirtoCommerce.Return 3.1005.0-pr-28-62f9 on vcptcore-dev; declared build equals deployed build

nodes.notes: integrates with: orders - eligibility, address email, customer and organization snapshots; b2b - organization membership, roles, active organization; notifications - templates, message log, Hangfire send; push - push.producer-returns; store-settings - the Return.* store settings.
